analysis: Price is attempting a breakout above the Value Area High despite persistent negative net CVD across both spot and perpetual markets, indicating a leverage-driven push lacking aggressive buy support. Without spot absorption to sustain current levels, the market faces heightened risk of a mean-reverting rotation back into value toward the Point of Control.
key_risk: Breakout failure above 75,800 VAH due to spot CVD divergence triggering an unwind back toward 75,700 POC.
